asA: beta reader trusting the referee-guarantees page's finalise refusal list
iWant: `rcf build finalise` to refuse promotion when the verify report carries UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING or SCOPE-MISMATCH on any AC
soThat: a UI baseline violation, a missing browser check on a UI-bearing FBS, a bound TC narrower than its AC scope, or a block-severity probe-pack failure all fail the gate the same way the mock-only and EVAL refusals already do
title: US-16201: finalise refuses on UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING and SCOPE-MISMATCH

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a verify PASS (exit 0, ship authority) whose report carries at least one per-AC UI-BASELINE-UNMET verdict, `rcf build finalise` exits 4 and leaves the FBS at 'complete'. The stderr message names the AC(s), the count of UI-BASELINE-UNMET verdicts, and the referee-guarantees claim ids C-28 and C-36 (a block-severity probe-pack failure aggregates into UI-BASELINE-UNMET, so the same branch closes both).
acceptanceCriteria.given: an FBS at status 'complete' and a stub verify subprocess whose report writes verdictAuthority='ship' and perAcVerdicts includes {acId, verdict: 'UI-BASELINE-UNMET'}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 4, the FBS on disk stays at 'complete', and stderr matches /UI-BASELINE-UNMET/ and /Referee-guarantees claims C-28 and C-36/

acceptanceCriteria.description: Same shape for BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING: a UI-bearing FBS with no browserVerification[] record aggregates into a per-AC verdict that finalise refuses. Exit 4, FBS at 'complete', stderr names C-29.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the same scaffold with perAcVerdicts = [{acId, verdict: 'BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING'}]
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 4 and stderr matches /BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING/ and /Referee-guarantees claim C-29/

acceptanceCriteria.description: Same shape for SCOPE-MISMATCH (NV-BL-GATE-01): a bound TC narrower than its AC scope aggregates into a per-AC SCOPE-MISMATCH verdict that finalise refuses. Exit 4, FBS at 'complete', stderr names C-30.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the same scaffold with perAcVerdicts = [{acId, verdict: 'SCOPE-MISMATCH'}]
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 4 and stderr matches /SCOPE-MISMATCH/ and /Referee-guarantees claim C-30/
